```yaml
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages with Version Bump

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # needed for tags

      - name: Set up Git user
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Read and bump version
        id: bump
        run: |
          VERSION_FILE="_includes/VERSION.txt"
          if [ ! -f "$VERSION_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Error: $VERSION_FILE not found" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          current=$(cat "$VERSION_FILE")
          if ! [[ "$current" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: $VERSION_FILE does not contain a valid integer" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          new=$((current + 1))
          printf "%s" "$new" > "$VERSION_FILE"
          echo "new_version=$new" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check for duplicate tag
        run: |
          tag="v${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_version }}"
          if git rev-parse "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Error: Tag $tag already exists" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Commit version bump
        run: |
          git add _includes/VERSION.txt
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to ${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_version }}"
          git push origin main

      - name: Create and push tag
        run: |
          tag="v${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_version }}"
          git tag "$tag"
          git push origin "$tag"

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.3

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Build Jekyll site
        run: bundle exec jekyll build

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./_site
          publish_branch: gh-pages
```
